program:
app "Household bills" home slate
table bill what text, amount money, category pick Electricity|Gas|Water|Internet|Rent
let spent = sum(bill.amount month)
setting budget money = 60000 "Monthly budget"
"Safe to spend" round(max(budget - spent, 0) / (monthdays(today) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day" faint
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
form bill
share bill month by category, sum(it.amount), it.key
daybars last 7 days, sum(bill.amount on it)
list bill month by day
remind "Add today's expenses" every 2h from 9:00 to 21:00
describe:
Household bills, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- bill: what: text; amount: money; category: one of Electricity, Gas, Water, Internet, Rent. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 60000.
Works out:
- spent is the total amount of bill this month.
Shows:
- text: "Safe to spend", the larger of budget minus spent and 0 divided by the result of the number of days in the month of today minus the day of the month of today plus 1 rounded, "a day".
- text: "Over budget by" when spent is more than budget, otherwise "Left to spend", budget minus spent without its sign.
- spent out of budget with a progress bar, labelled "spent".
- a form to add a bill.
- bars that compare the total amount of the item across group of bill entries this month by category.
- a bar chart of the total amount of bill on that day for each day in the last 7 days.
- a list of bill this month by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
Reminder "Add today's expenses" every 2 hours from 9:00 to 21:00.

program:
app "Carrom tournament" trophy plum
table point team pick Pair_A|Pair_B, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Pair_A)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Pair_B)
setting winat num = 29 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Pair A" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Pair_A, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Pair_A, pts = 2
      button "+3" tap add point team = Pair_A, pts = 3
  stack card grow align center
    "Pair B" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Pair_B, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Pair_B, pts = 2
      button "+3" tap add point team = Pair_B, pts = 3
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Pair A win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Pair B win!" head color good
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
list point
describe:
Carrom tournament, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Pair A, Pair B; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 29.
Works out:
- a is the total pts of point where team is Pair A.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Pair B.
Shows:
- text: "Pair A".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Pair A, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Pair A, pts set to 2.
- a button "+3"; a tap adds a point with team set to Pair A, pts set to 3.
- text: "Pair B".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Pair B, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Pair B, pts set to 2.
- a button "+3"; a tap adds a point with team set to Pair B, pts set to 3.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Pair A win!".
- if b is at least winat:
  - text: "Pair B win!".
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.
- a list of point; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: all lowercase, no punctuation, 2 to 8 words
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: start with the most unusual feature

program:
app "Salon products" star mint
table product_s name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 5, price money?, kind pick Dry|Fresh|Frozen, expires date?
state q text = ""
let short = count(product_s, it.qty <= it.low)
short "products running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each product_s where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(product_s, it.qty * it.price) faint
form product_s
remind "Check your products" at 9:00 on sat
describe:
Salon products, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- product s: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 5; price: money, optional; kind: one of Dry, Fresh, Frozen; expires: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the product s have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "products running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each product s where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the product s for editing; a swipe removes the product s, with undo:
    - text: the name of the product s.
    - text: the kind of the product s.
    - text: "Expires", the expires of the product s.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the product s to the qty of the product s minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the product s.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the product s to the qty of the product s plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the product s.
- a form to add a product s.
Reminder "Check your products" at 9:00 on Sat.

program:
app "Fridge" milk ocean
table food_item name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 3, price money?, kind pick Dry|Fresh|Frozen, expires date?
state q text = ""
let short = count(food_item, it.qty <= it.low)
short "food running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each food_item where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(food_item, it.qty * it.price) faint
form food_item
remind "Check your food" at 9:00 on sat
describe:
Fridge, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- food item: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 3; price: money, optional; kind: one of Dry, Fresh, Frozen; expires: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the food item have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "food running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each food item where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the food item for editing; a swipe removes the food item, with undo:
    - text: the name of the food item.
    - text: the kind of the food item.
    - text: "Expires", the expires of the food item.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the food item to the qty of the food item minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the food item.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the food item to the qty of the food item plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the food item.
- a form to add a food item.
Reminder "Check your food" at 9:00 on Sat.
